bindings.label: Wart-like lesions developed on the patient's face 2 weeks after facial rejuvenation procedure
A white woman in her 60s presented for facial rejuvenation with panfacial lipoatrophy and photodamaged skin, and a medical history of nasal basal cell carcinoma.
She underwent fractional CO2 laser resurfacing and fat transfer to her temples, forehead, and midface.
Physical examination revealed firm, verrucoid keratotic papules on the face that were itchy and irritated.
The lesions did not respond to conservative treatment including hydrocortisone, mupirocin ointment, and topical crisaborole ointment.
Two biopsies showed verrucous actinic keratosis with atypical squamous proliferation and no koilocytes or viral cytopathic effect
Patient has verrucous actinic keratosis (precancerous keratosis)
